title: Permutation
statementMd:
"Hey, it's homework time" — thought Polycarpus and of course he started with his favourite subject, IT. Polycarpus managed to solve all tasks but for the last one in 20 minutes. However, as he failed to solve the last task after some considerable time, the boy asked you to help him.

The sequence of $*n*$ integers is called a permutation if it contains all integers from $1$ to $*n*$ exactly once.

You are given an arbitrary sequence $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*n*}$ containing $*n*$ integers. Each integer is not less than $1$ and not greater than $5000$. Determine what minimum number of elements Polycarpus needs to change to get a permutation (he should not delete or add numbers). In a single change he can modify any single sequence element (i. e. replace it with another integer).

## Input

The first line of the input data contains an integer $*n*$ ($1 ≤ *n* ≤ 5000$) which represents how many numbers are in the sequence. The second line contains a sequence of integers $*a*_{*i*}$ ($1 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ 5000, 1 ≤ *i* ≤ *n*$).

## Output

Print the only number — the minimum number of changes needed to get the permutation.

## Note

The first sample contains the permutation, which is why no replacements are required.

In the second sample it is enough to replace the first element with the number 1 and that will make the sequence the needed permutation.

In the third sample we can replace the second element with number 4 and the fourth element with number 2.
statementZhMd:
“嘿，到了做作业的时间了”——Polycarpus 这样想着，当然，他先开始做自己最喜欢的科目——信息技术。Polycarpus 在 20 分钟内解决了除最后一道题以外的所有题目。然而，在花费了相当长的时间后，他仍然没能解决最后一道题，于是这个男孩请求你帮助他。

如果一个由 $*n*$ 个整数组成的序列恰好包含从 $1$ 到 $*n*$ 的所有整数各一次，那么这个序列就称为一个排列。

给定一个任意的由 $*n*$ 个整数组成的序列 $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*n*}$。每个整数都不小于 $1$ 且不大于 $5000$。请确定 Polycarpus 至少需要修改多少个元素，才能将该序列变为一个排列（不能删除或添加数字）。一次修改中，他可以修改序列中的任意一个元素（即将其替换为另一个整数）。

## 输入格式

输入数据的第一行包含一个整数 $*n*$（$1 ≤ *n* ≤ 5000$），表示序列中数字的个数。第二行包含一个整数序列 $*a*_{*i}$（$1 ≤ *a*_{*i} ≤ 5000, 1 ≤ *i* ≤ *n*$）。

## 输出格式

输出一个数字——将序列变为排列所需的最少修改次数。

## 说明

第一个样例中的序列本身就是一个排列，因此不需要进行任何替换。

在第二个样例中，只需将第一个元素替换为数字 1，就能使序列变为所需的排列。

在第三个样例中，可以将第二个元素替换为数字 4，并将第四个元素替换为数字 2。
